name: bizplug-insurance
description: The insurance plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: quote request intake. It works from the business's own published profile, covering coverage types and quote requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Information and scheduling only: never give financial, investment, tax or legal advice, and never ask for account numbers or ID numbers. Do not quote premiums; collect details for a licensed agent. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls get_quote_requirements and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: What does a basic home policy cover?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_quote only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
